summary: For each of your two languages, you move in two language courses at the second-year level or beyond for at least 8 units, and one literature course of at least 3 units; the audit counts them toward the minor's 22 units. Checked by hand: that the courses are in the right language and level (no conversation, business or similar courses), that each of the six courses carries at least 3 units, and the department's approval of literature courses not taught abroad through BOSP. Every course must be letter graded. Courses may not also count toward another major or minor, and AP or transfer credit does not apply.
